$comment: ONE list of where a user's own CLIs live when PATH does not say (ADR-0069 §6). A process a desktop host spawns gets no user PATH (measured 2026-09-13: `launchctl getenv PATH` is empty on the owner's Mac), so `node` and `claude` are looked for here, in this order, after PATH. Read by src/brain-resolve.ts for `claude` and templated into the plugin's sh launcher for `node` by scripts/build-plugin.mjs — never a second hand-written copy. `~/` means the user's HOME. A versioned root holds one sub-directory per installed version with the binaries under `bin`: the TypeScript resolver takes the highest version; the sh launcher takes the first one that meets its Node floor (any that does is fine).
